data.notes: The header, tag and reason are right: the review names the value case built from Ines's own data and the month-end close as the real buy, invents no dollar figure and keeps Fiserv's pitch unknown. Trigger, message and competitor all say 'lead with the close/reconciliation', so they overlap; it also misses offering a named contact against bank incumbents, the counter-reader demo gap, and making the customer-data value analysis a standard step.
